answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. Top-1 agreement is 0.957, sequence agreement 0.688, KL 0.039 and Token-DiFR gap 0.037, all at or near the quantized range (0.945-0.955, 0.67-0.70, 0.039-0.071, 0.03-0.04). They sit clearly outside the fine-tuned range (KL 0.081+, top-1 at most 0.938, gap 0.10+) and the system-prompted range (KL 0.197+, top-1 at most 0.908). TV of 0.040 is slightly below the quantized range of 0.048-0.055, and raw-score shift ÷ TV of 2.8 is a bit above the quantized 2.2-2.3 but below the fine-tuned maximum. These are small deviations, plausible for a single draw. The values are non-zero, so base is ruled out. A mild fine-tune is the closest alternative.
